description: This file defines a culture info object for the Portuguese (Brazil) locale within a date handling library (Date.js). It contains locale-specific date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates in pt-BR, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of the date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date to the current system time.
